hook: Jassy became President and CEO of Amazon on July 5, 2021, succeeding founder Jeff Bezos. He joined Amazon in 1997, helped conceive Amazon Web Services in 2003, and served as CEO of AWS from 2016 until his move to the top role, later making Amazon Bedrock generally available as a foundation model service for AWS customers.
name: Andy Jassy

quote.text: The opportunity and risk is pretty similar in that there is this wildly transformative, disruptive technology in generative AI.
quote.context: Andy Jassy, remarks reported from a conversation at Davos, Fortune, January 18, 2024

primary.name: Andrew R. Jassy, President and Chief Executive Officer, Amazon Investor Relations
AWS announces the general availability of Amazon Bedrock, About Amazon, September 28, 2023

secondary.name: Amazon CEO Andy Jassy says AI is the biggest risk and opportunity, Fortune, January 18, 2024

timeline.event: Joins Amazon as a marketing manager
timeline.impact: Begins a career at the company he will later lead.

timeline.event: Leads the launch of Amazon Web Services
timeline.impact: Builds the cloud infrastructure business that becomes a major profit engine for Amazon.

timeline.event: Becomes President and CEO of Amazon on July 5, 2021
timeline.impact: Succeeds founder Jeff Bezos as chief executive.

timeline.event: Amazon Bedrock reaches general availability on September 28, 2023
timeline.impact: Extends AWS's generative AI offering to customers building on foundation models.

quick_facts: President and Chief Executive Officer of Amazon.com
Joined Amazon as a marketing manager in 1997
Helped conceive Amazon Web Services in 2003 and led it from launch in 2006
Served as CEO of AWS from April 2016 until July 2021
Became President and CEO of Amazon on July 5, 2021
Oversaw Amazon Bedrock reaching general availability on September 28, 2023

achievements.title: Amazon Web Services
achievements.impact: Helped conceive AWS in 2003, led its original team at launch in 2006, and served as its CEO from 2016 to 2021, building it into a leading cloud infrastructure provider.

achievements.title: Amazon Bedrock
achievements.impact: Reached general availability on September 28, 2023, giving AWS customers managed access to multiple foundation models for building generative AI applications.
